title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Assistant Accountant

Salary: £25,000

Location: Leeds

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: 37.5 hours per week

About the Company

We are a modern, forward-thinking and cloud-first accountancy practice providing accounting services to a varied portfolio of small businesses, sole traders and limited companies.

Operating in a collaborative, technology-driven environment, the practice places a strong emphasis on employee development, career progression and creating a supportive workplace. With a growing team and a commitment to developing talent, this is an excellent opportunity to join an established and expanding practice.

About the Role

An opportunity has arisen for an Assistant Accountant to join the team, supporting the delivery of bookkeeping, payroll and accounts preparation services to a varied client base.

This role would suit someone with previous accountancy practice experience who has a basic understanding of bookkeeping, payroll and accounts preparation and is keen to develop their technical knowledge and progress their career.

Working alongside experienced accountants, you will gain exposure to a range of accounting duties, receive guidance and training, and gradually take on additional responsibilities as your experience and confidence grow.

The successful candidate will be organised, detail-oriented and motivated to learn, with a genuine interest in developing a long-term career in accountancy.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting with bookkeeping and maintaining accurate financial records for a range of clients.
- Supporting the preparation of accounts for sole traders and limited companies.
- Assisting with payroll processing and associated administration.
- Processing purchase and sales invoices, bank transactions and financial records.
- Carrying out bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies.
- Assisting with VAT returns and other routine financial submissions.
- Maintaining accurate client records and ensuring financial information is up to date.
- Liaising with colleagues and clients to obtain missing information and resolve queries.
- Supporting the wider accounting team with day-to-day duties and meeting relevant deadlines.
- Developing technical knowledge across bookkeeping, payroll, accounts preparation and other areas of accountancy.

Experience & Requirements
- Previous experience working within an accountancy practice is essential.
- Practical experience in bookkeeping, payroll and basic accounts preparation.
- A basic understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.
- Good attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage workloads effectively.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn and develop new skills.
- Competent IT skills, with experience using accounting software being advantageous.

Qualifications
- A degree in Accounting, Finance or a related subject would be advantageous but is not essential.
- AAT studies or a willingness to pursue an accounting qualification would be beneficial.
- Candidates with relevant accountancy practice experience and a strong desire to develop their technical skills are encouraged to apply.

Working Pattern & Flexibility
- Working Hours:5 hours per week.
- Flexible Working: Flexible working arrangements may be available following the initial training period, subject to the practice's requirements.
- Hybrid Working: The opportunity to work from home is available following successful completion of the probation period.
- Office Environment: A collaborative and supportive workplace, with opportunities to learn directly from experienced colleagues.

Salary & Benefits
- Salary: Approximately £25,000, depending on experience.
- Annual Leave: 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays.
- Study Support: Financial support of up to £500 per exam or module towards eligible AAT, ACCA or CTA studies, reimbursed following successful completion of probation.
- Paid Study Leave: Two paid study days per module, comprising one exam day and one revision day.
- Hybrid Working: The opportunity to work from home following successful completion of probation.
- Career Progression: Clear opportunities to progress into more senior accounting positions as technical knowledge and experience develop.
- Training & Development: Practical, on-the-job training and support from experienced members of the team.
- Company Culture: A friendly, collaborative working environment with a casual dress code.
- Social Events: Regular team and employee-welfare activities, including sports days, coffee mornings and other informal social events.

- Contribute to the ongoing improvement of finance processes, ensuring work is completed efficiently and in accordance with company policies.
- Handle sensitive financial information responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and a consistently high level of accuracy.

Essential:
- AAT qualified
- Strong Excel and finance system knowledge
- Strong attention to detail and comfort working with repetitive, high-volume tasks.
- Willingness to adapt as the team introduces system and process improvements.
- Good communication skills and a proactive approach.

title: Care Navigator/Receptionist
description: Due to a member of the team upskilling into a new role, we are seeking a Care Navigator/Receptionist to join our fast-paced reception and administration team. We are looking for individuals who feel they will be able to settle into a busy practice, whilst able to work independently and as part of a team. Previous primary care or GP surgery experience is desirable, although applicants with relevant transferable skills will also be considered. Provide a professional and welcoming first point of contact for patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. Manage a busy telephone system, responding to enquiries and directing patients to the most appropriate service. Book, amend and cancel patient appointments in accordance with practice protocols. Receive patients at the reception desk, recording arrivals and assisting with enquiries. Process repeat prescription requests in line with practice procedures. Deal with incoming emails, post and other administrative correspondence. Liaise effectively with GPs, nurses, pharmacists, hospitals and other healthcare organisations. Carry out administrative tasks relating to patient records, including scanning, document management and filing. Follow practice protocols to ensure consistent and high-quality care is provided to our patients. Act as directed by other members of the practice team. Provide reception and administrative cover for colleagues during periods of annual leave or sickness absence. Work across both Ireland Wood and Horsforth practice sites when required. Ensure confidentiality is always maintained in accordance with General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and practice policies. The Care Navigator/Receptionist is an essential member of the practice team, providing a professional, efficient and patient-focused reception and administrative service across both practice sites. Working closely with the Practice Manager, GP Partners and the wider clinical and administrative teams, the post-holder will help ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the practice while delivering excellent customer service to patients and visitors. A key part of the role is supporting patients with their queries and appointment requests, helping them to access the most appropriate healthcare professional or service in line with practice protocols. The post-holder will manage appointments, respond to telephone and face-to-face enquiries, process repeat prescription requests and undertake a range of administrative duties to support the delivery of safe and effective patient care. The role also includes maintaining accurate patient records, processing correspondence and supporting communication with hospitals, pharmacies and other healthcare organisations. The post-holder will work in accordance with practice policies, maintain confidentiality at all times, and provide cover for colleagues and across both practice sites when required. Overall, this is a varied and rewarding role that requires excellent communication, organisational and IT skills, together with the ability to work calmly and effectively in a busy environment while providing a high standard of patient care and customer service.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: A new opportunity has arisen for a medical receptionist to join our team. The vacancy is part time, working 20 hours per week Monday 08:00 - 13:00 Thursday 08:00 - 14:00 Friday 08:30 - 18:30 Receptionists are the first line of contact with our patients. This is a varied role that includes face to face and telephone contact with patients as well as administrative duties. It requires a high level of attention to detail to ensure an excellent service is provided to both our patients and the clinical and non-clinical staff at the practice. Job Title: Medical Receptionist Location: Harrogate Road or Harehills Community Health Centre Hours per week: 20 Hours per week Reports to : Reception Supervisor DBS Check: Enhanced Check Job Summary Duties and responsibilities: Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointments system; Processing personal and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations, and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail Dealing with enquiries via email. Taking messages and passing on information for clinical and non-clinical staff Filing and retrieving paperwork, recording and receipting of petty cash. Processing repeat prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines. Processing, all repeat medication requests sent in by patients using the various protocols in place. Collecting repeat prescription requests from post box and reception. Liaising with patients and chemists regarding queries and requests Ensuring repeat medication is issued in line with the protocols that are already in place, and ensure that any queries raised are dealt with quickly and correctly. Ensuring that patient queries on medication are highlighted to the relevant GP. Regularly go through prescriptions not picked up and unlikely to be picked up as a result of the timescale, to remove the details from the patient records and then destroy the prescription. Accurate computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team member and associated healthcare agencies and providers Ensuring incoming colleagues are fully briefed on any urgent or unresolved issues. Organising appropriate patient transport such as ambulances and taxis Providing clerical assistance to practice staff as required from time to time, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning. Keeping the reception area, noticeboards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter. Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols. Maintaining a high level of confidence when dealing with Patient information and data in line with the Practices Confidentiality policies. Health & safety: Assist in promoting and maintaining your own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice health & safety policy, the practice health & safety manual, and the practice infection control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines. Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks. Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills. Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way, free from hazards. Actively reporting health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised. Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holders role Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually); Reporting potential risks identified Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and diversity: Support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/professional development: Participate in any training programmes implemented by the practice as part of this employment, with such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work. Quality: Strive to maintain quality within the practice by : Alerting other team members to issues of quality and risk Assessing own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contributing to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Working effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources.

title: Care Navigator/ Medical Receptionist
description: South Queen Street Medical Centre are looking to appoint a care navigator/ receptionist to join our busy GP practice who will be the first point of contact for patients, contractors, and visitors as well as carrying out general office management tasks. Working pattern 5 hours per day, 5 days a week, alternate weekly am & pm shifts, 8am-630pm. Flexibility and overtime will be required for this role. You will be responsible for the general reception duties within the Practice and work with our established processes, policies, and procedures to provide a comprehensive high-quality service and deal efficiently and courteously with patient enquiries. You will receive, assist, and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. You will provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. You will have excellent communication skills, a compassionate and friendly nature who can operate in a busy environment with a range of people and professions, as you will be working with our clinical and administration teams. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organised and an effective communicator who can provide a professional and warm welcome to our patients, ensuring every contact is of the highest quality. IT skills are essential, as you will be regularly creating searches, data input and monitoring our achievements and progress against national, local, and internal targets. You will also process prescription requests and provide a full administrative service. GCSE grade C or above in English and Maths is essential for this role. Key Duties and Responsibilities Patient Reception and Customer Service Act as the first point of contact for patients, visitors and healthcare professionals, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Welcome patients in a friendly, respectful and professional manner. Respond to general enquiries and provide accurate information about practice services, opening hours and appointment procedures. Deal sensitively with patients who may be anxious, distressed, frustrated or experiencing difficult personal circumstances. Maintain a clean, organised and welcoming reception and waiting area. Manage challenging situations professionally and escalate complaints or concerns to the appropriate member of the practice team. Care Navigation and Appointment Management Handle patient requests for appointments, advice and access to healthcare services by telephone and in person. Use approved care navigation protocols to direct patients to the most appropriate clinician or service, including GPs, practice nurses, clinical pharmacists, physiotherapists and other available services where appropriate. Gather relevant non-clinical information to help determine the appropriate appointment pathway, without attempting to diagnose medical conditions. Book, amend and cancel appointments using the practices clinical computer system. Identify potentially urgent concerns in accordance with practice procedures and promptly escalate them to a clinician. Provide information about alternative services, such as NHS 111, where appropriate and in accordance with practice guidance. Maintain accurate records of patient contacts and appointment requests. Telephone and Administrative Duties Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and manage a busy call queue efficiently. Handle patient messages and ensure they are passed to the appropriate member of the clinical or administrative team. Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice policies and direct medication queries to the appropriate professional. Register new patients and update demographic details, contact information and other relevant records. Manage incoming and outgoing post, emails and electronic communications. Assist with administrative tasks, including recalling patients for appointments, supporting clinical audits and maintaining accurate practice records. Monitor outstanding administrative tasks and follow up requests within agreed timescales. Clinical Systems and Data Management Use the practices electronic clinical system, SystmOne, to access and update patient information. Ensure patient details, appointment information and messages are recorded accurately and promptly. Handle sensitive patient information securely and maintain strict confidentiality at all times. Comply with UK GDPR, data protection legislation, information governance requirements and practice policies. Follow procedures for accessing, storing and sharing patient information appropriately. Teamwork and Practice Support Work collaboratively with GPs, nurses, healthcare assistants, pharmacists, care coordinators and administrative colleagues. Attend staff meetings and training sessions as required. Support colleagues during busy periods and assist with the day-to-day organisation of reception services. Follow practice policies relating to health and safety, infection prevention, safeguarding and equality and diversity. Report incidents, risks and concerns to the appropriate manager. Undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role to support the effective operation of the practice. Training and Development The successful candidate will receive induction and training appropriate to the role, including practice procedures, clinical systems, information governance, confidentiality, safeguarding, health and safety and care navigation. Ongoing training and development will be encouraged to support the delivery of a safe, efficient and high-quality patient service. Personal Qualities We are looking for someone who is approachable, empathetic, dependable and proactive. The successful candidate must demonstrate patience, discretion and professionalism when dealing with sensitive situations and be committed to treating every patient with dignity, respect and fairness. Working Conditions The postholder will work within a busy GP practice and may be required to work flexibly according to the needs of the service. Working hours, salary, annual leave and other employment terms will be confirmed during recruitment.

title: GP Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: We are recruiting for a Care Navigator to join our team. The role will be part time, and you must be available to work Friday evenings up until 18:30pm. Working within the Robin Lane reception team, the post-holder will help provide a friendly and welcoming service for all patients. The Care Navigator will support patients to access the right health care in a professional and efficient manner. Follow practice processes to actively signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional and service, whilst handling any complex queries and challenging situations in a professional manner, ensuring any issues are resolved where possible, at the first point of contact. Assist both clinical and admin colleagues with the smooth running of the reception area and surgery building.The post-holder is expected to comply with the employment policies and procedures, with due regard to clinical and information governance policies and procedures, and any other policies and procedures necessary for the safe and effective discharge of the duties contained within this document. This job description is subject to a flexibility clause and may change according to business requirements. This advert may close early should the right candidate be found. To welcome patients presenting either in person or by telephone; ensuring you respond promptly and positively. Book appointments for patients and cancel appointments where needed. Support patients in navigating to the most appropriate service, which may include informing patients of external health care providers and online services. Effectively handle all queries that present at the practice; problem solving, signposting and escalation of matters, as appropriate. Ensure patient records are accurate and kept up to date and that all patient contacts are documented in the system using the Care Navigation Template. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare providers. Carrying out administrative duties which include scanning, tasks, out of hours reports, new patient registrations (including basic urine dip), opening and sorting of post (both internal and external), photocopying reports, updating patient details, filing INR reports and data inputting as requested. Processing medication requests, including issuing repeat medication and appliance items, as well as forwarding patient requests onto the practice pharmacy team/on-call GP. Communicating effectively with local pharmacy staff and resolving/investigating any queries they may have. Processing e-consults via system one and triaging the patient accordingly using signposting where necessary. Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols. Carry out chronic disease recalls and vaccination campaigns, booking relevant appointments working from a list to ensure clinics are fully utilised Informing patients of test results and following up with instructions from clinicians. Keeping the reception area and notice boards clean, tidy and up to date. Taking payments for private documents from patients and providing receipts Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required. Assisting the Site Co-ordinator with weekly fire alarm checks and weekly/monthly legionella testing, when required. Assisting the Site Co-ordinator with weekly room plans and petty cash records, when required. To be able to work with people from a wide variety of cultures and backgrounds, and people with disabilities and learning difficulties, and to be able to communicate with them (and, when necessary, their carers) appropriately to facilitate their care and understanding of their care within the service. Attend and positively contribute to team meetings. Fully comply with all company Health and Safety requirements, including reporting all accidents, near accidents, and hazards. Treat all patients fairly and with respect. Provide cover across all sites as required. This is not an exhaustive list, and it is expected that this role will develop as the business grows.
